fields.value: Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX is a video game released in 2000 featuring BMX Rider Dave Mirra and other professional BMX riders. It was developed by Z-Axis Ltd. and published by Acclaim Entertainment under their Acclaim Max Sports label. The game was released on the PlayStation, Game Boy Color, Dreamcast and Microsoft Windows. The player's main objective in the game is to choose one of the riders and work their way through a total of 12 different levels, completing objectives to unlock new equipment. A sequel was released in 2001 entitled Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 2.

Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX es un videojuego lanzado en 2000 que presenta al piloto de BMX Dave Mirra y a otros pilotos profesionales de BMX. Fue desarrollado por Z-Axis Ltd. y publicado por Acclaim Entertainment bajo su sello Acclaim Max Sports. Salió para PlayStation, Game Boy Color, Dreamcast y Microsoft Windows. El objetivo principal consiste en elegir a uno de los pilotos y avanzar por un total de 12 niveles, completando objetivos para desbloquear nuevo equipo. En 2001 se lanzó una secuela titulada Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 2.
